observations: Photo shows a white game console resting on cardboard boxes, console body visible from the top/side only, no rear or label visible.

Two red-and-white boxes labeled 'Wireless Controller' are shown, with small text reading 'FOR Switch/PS4/PS3/Xbox' - these appear to be generic third-party controllers, not an official Sony DualShock controller.
A black power cable with a UK-style plug is coiled on top of the console.
No HDMI cable, no original PlayStation box, no serial number sticker, no model number (e.g. CUH-7xxx) visible anywhere in the photo.
No power-on test, no UI/display shown, no scuffs or damage visible but also no close-up of console surface.

claims.evidence: No model number, serial sticker, or rear panel is visible in photo 0 to confirm Pro vs standard PS4 vs Slim.

claims.claim: Get the ultimate gaming experience... smoother gameplay, faster...
claims.evidence: Marketing language; no benchmark, performance clip, or power-on test shown.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults (overheating, HDD failure, disc drive issues)
risks.proof: A clip of the console powering on to the home screen, or at least the light turning on with a beep

risks.risk: Console could be a base PS4 or PS4 Slim mislabeled as Pro, which affects price significantly
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear/bottom panel showing the model number (e.g., CUH-7xxx for Pro)
risks.if_unproven: priced as base/unverified model, not as Pro

risks.risk: No official DualShock 4 controller included, only generic third-party pads shown
risks.proof: A photo of an original Sony DualShock 4 controller if included
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, without original controller

risks.risk: No HDMI cable or original box shown, which may indicate incomplete accessory set
risks.proof: A photo of all included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as console + power cable only

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rear/bottom panel showing the model number sticker
Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen
Photo of all accessories included (HDMI cable, original controller if any, original box)
response.reason: The photo does not show any model number or serial label to confirm this is actually a PS4 Pro rather than a base model, and there is no evidence the unit powers on, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without this missing proof.
